0022600149.text: The Pelicans, 1-4 and 12th in the West, host the Atlanta Hawks, who are 3-3 and first in the Southeast, after New Orleans won its most recent game. New Orleans will be without Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain), and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). There have been no games between the teams in 2026-27, and the Pelicans lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 117-100 loss in Atlanta on January 7, 2026.
